english: Optional and customizable. Blocks a wide range of offensive or vulgar language on your end.
Don’t want to see or hear a specific player’s text or voice? Mute or block them, any time, no explanation needed.
Reduce how often you’re matched with a specific player. All players get 4 Avoids by default. Avoiding others, and being avoided, both carry matchmaking effects.
Play your assigned role. Taking another player’s role or refusing to follow team composition disrupts the match for everyone.
Destroying, selling, or dropping items in bad faith, or trading items to benefit the enemy team, is not allowed.
Using abilities to intentionally harm or endanger teammates, block movement, or benefit the enemy team is not allowed.

Reborn is built to be competitive, and competition gets heated. We’re not interested in policing every word said in the heat of a close game. What we are interested in is making sure the game is actually enjoyable to play.

Reborn is built to be competitive, and competition gets heated. We’re not interested in policing every word said in the heat of a close game. What we are interested in is making sure the game is actually enjoyable to play, and that means having real standards for behavior that gets in the way of that: griefing, harassment, cheating, and sabotage.

We give you tools to control your own experience first. Beyond that, we now have a real moderation system in place, backed by both automated review and a community Moderation Team, to handle the things a mute button can’t fix.
These are your first line of defense. Use them freely, they don’t require a report or a review, and they take effect immediately.

Reports carry weight based on your track record over time. Confirmed reports strengthen the weight of your future reports; reports that don’t hold up will carry less weight. A commend system, letting you recognize good teammates, is planned for a future update.

You have 5 reports available per 7-day period. This resets at the same day and time each week for everyone, it’s a flat number, not refunded for confirmed reports and not increased for good standing. Use them for things that are actually worth reporting, this isn’t a limit meant to stop you from reporting real problems, it’s there so reports stay meaningful.

Confirmed communication violations result in an automatic mute. Your first confirmed violation only mutes you for the remainder of that match, after that, mute duration increases with each repeated violation:
Mute duration by number of confirmed communication violations
A confirmed communication violation expires from your active history 180 days after it’s issued and no longer counts toward a future mute’s duration.

Confirmed Intentional Feeding, Ability / Item Abuse, Role Refusal, AFK and Not Participating reports use a point system instead of a single flat penalty. A panel of GMs decides whether or not the accused is guilty, and the resulting consequence is calculated automatically from your account’s history. GMs don’t assign your punishment directly.

All confirmed infractions share one pool, regardless of category. A Minor here and a Major there still add up. As long as your account has at least 1 active point, 1 point expires every 15 days, so the consequence you’re facing is always based on your current active total, not everything you’ve ever done:

If you’ve already served a serious suspension, repeat serious misconduct can carry a harsher penalty than the standard ladder above at Senior GM or Staff discretion, this is decided case by case upon review, not by a fixed public formula.

These don’t go through the point system above. They’re reviewed directly by Kongor Studios Staff, not the volunteer Moderation Team, and carry their own consequences: rating rollback and reward clawback for boosting, a hardware restriction on permanent bans tied to cheating, and, where an action like exploiting a bug has measurably skewed a player’s stats, Staff may correct the affected stats directly.
Permanent bans are rare and are never triggered automatically, they’re reserved for confirmed cheating software, account theft, organized match fixing, and similar serious cases.
It is up to the decision of the Kongor Studios Staff on what the penalty is and they reserve the right to apply any such penalty as deemed appropriate.

Every griefing report goes to a randomly and anonymously assigned panel of Moderation Team volunteers (GMs). Panel members review independently and never see who else is on the panel or what anyone else has decided until everyone has submitted.
More serious report categories are reviewed by a larger panel. A heavy majority of the panel has to agree, on what happened, the category, and how serious it was, before a verdict is finalized.

If the panel can’t reach that level of agreement, the case goes to a Senior GM for a final decision. This keeps the small Senior GM team focused on the genuinely contested cases instead of every case that happens to have a mixed panel.
What GMs Can and Can’t Do
This is worth stating plainly, since it’s easy to assume a moderator has more power than they actually do:

This is a deliberate change from how Reborn has handled behavior reports in the past. We’re investing real time and people into reviewing reports, because griefing and toxicity have been a real problem, and self-moderation tools alone weren’t enough to fix it.

Smurfing and Boosting are both reportable. If you believe you’re facing a smurf, an account playing well below the skill level of the player behind it, or a boosted account, report it, and it goes directly to Senior GM / Staff investigation.

Reporting isn’t our only defense. Reborn ties matchmaking eligibility to a single main account per machine. Once you’ve played a match on an account, matchmaking on any other account on that machine is restricted until a formal account-switch process is completed. Reporting exists for the cases this system-level prevention doesn’t catch.
Think a mute or penalty was a mistake? You can appeal.

These aren’t part of the formal appeals queue, they’re short or minor enough that review would usually outlast them. If you believe one of these was a clear error, reach out to general support instead.
— Submit your appeal at heroesofnewerth.com/support and select the appeal option when creating a post. This is the only way to file an appeal.
— Every appeal is reviewed by a person, not just re-run through the automated system. Target response time is 3 business days; cases needing translation review may take a little longer.
Appeals exist to catch mistakes, false reports, or cases of mistaken identity. They aren’t a way to negotiate down a penalty that was correctly issued.

Kongor Studios reserves the right to update or amend this Code of Conduct to protect fair play, competitive integrity, and community trust. By playing Reborn, you acknowledge and agree to abide by this Code of Conduct.

Certain infractions are given Penalty Points (PP). Each penalty's points are accumulated over time. Increased PP accumulation will result in increasing degrees of punishment. A single PP is removed for each game played with no additional infractions.
russian: За некоторые нарушения начисляются штрафные очки (PP). Они накапливаются, а вместе с ними ужесточаются наказания. За каждый матч без новых нарушений снимается одно PP.

english: Ravenor Unleashed, Role Priorities, Death Cost Overhaul, Report Penalties Live, and Harsher Dodge Penalties.
russian: Ravenor вырывается на свободу: приоритеты ролей, переработка цены смерти, наказания по жалобам и более строгие штрафы за выход из лобби.

english: In-Game Patch Notes, Replay Downloads, Post-Match Summary Overhaul, and Bug Fixes.
russian: Описание патчей в игре, загрузка повторов, переработанная сводка матча и исправления ошибок.

english: Role Queue, Kick System Replaced, Penalty Points Reset, and New Hero Revenant.
russian: Очередь по ролям, новая система исключения, сброс штрафных очков и новый герой Revenant.

english: Revamped Guide System, Midwars Map Update, Announcer Mute Options, and Winter Theme Farewell.
russian: Переработанная система руководств, обновление карты MidWars, отключение диктора и прощание с зимней темой.

english: Master of Arms arrives with his versatile weapon kit, hero balance updates, and QoL improvements.
russian: Master of Arms прибывает со своим универсальным арсеналом, обновлениями баланса героев и улучшениями удобства.

english: Ranked Midwars, Notification System Overhaul, and Immediate Match Submission.
russian: Рейтинговый MidWars, переработка уведомлений и мгновенная отправка результатов матча.

english: Christmas theme is here, new Plinko board, new Cosmetics, and QoL changes.
russian: Рождественская тема, новое поле Plinko, новая косметика и улучшения удобства.

english: Deadwood joins the roster with leaderboard, cosmetics, matchmaking, and Kill Effect upgrades.
russian: Deadwood пополняет список героев: обновления таблицы лидеров, косметики, подбора матчей и эффектов убийства.

english: Performance-focused patch with major FPS gains, smoother teamfights, and improved abandon rules.
russian: Патч производительности: заметный прирост FPS, более плавные командные бои и улучшенные правила выхода из матча.

english: Pre-Open Beta patch featuring Plinko, new items, balance updates, and Engineer’s comeback.
russian: Патч перед открытой бетой: Plinko, новые предметы, изменения баланса и возвращение Engineer.

english: MVPs are awarded to players who contribute significantly to their team's success, including high kills, assists, and game-winning plays.
russian: Звание MVP получают игроки, внёсшие решающий вклад в победу команды: множеством убийств и содействий или ключевыми действиями.

english: A kill streak is a sequence of kills in a row, where the player kills an enemy hero without dying.
russian: Серия убийств — несколько вражеских героев, убитых подряд без собственной смерти.

english: Annihilations are a measure of a player's ability to destroy enemy heroes in a single game.
russian: Аннигиляции показывают, насколько успешно игрок расправляется с вражескими героями за один матч.

english: Smackdowns are a measure of a player's ability to destroy enemy heroes in a single game.
russian: Смакдауны показывают, насколько успешно игрок расправляется с вражескими героями за один матч.

english: Wards are placed to help the player and their team see the map better.
russian: Варды дают игроку и его команде обзор на карте.
